items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Ernie Wilkins played a big part in Basie's 'Shiny Stockings.' ... We played it last night.

ctx.x: Which one -- Frank Foster did "Every Day," didn't he? I think.
Oh, was it? Well, Frank Foster did the one on the back, "The Comeback," which was practically as good.
